newsitem.title: USA: Perrigo Q2 Dec 31 net up on record sales.
newsitem.headline: Perrigo Q2 Dec 31 net up on record sales.

text.p: Perrigo Co said record sales in the second quarter ended December 31, along with higher gross margins, sent earnings moderately higher.

The company reported net income of $13.7 million, or $0.18 a share, compared to $12.2 million, or $0.16 a share, in the corresponding quarter one year ago. Sales reached $221.7 million, up from $201.0 million in 1995.
Perrigo said its over-the-counter pharmaceutical and nutritional business posted double-digit sales increases.
Perrigo is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 Tuesday at 10-3/4.
